purpose: Pre-register one end-to-end parity card before any new API or GPU call; establish whether the benchmark and baseline matrix can identify the value of situated evidence.

no_update.read: sealed initial state plus current public context

raw_acceptance.purpose: measure responsibility-aware evidence increment over raw acceptance

terminal_only.purpose: measure value of situated evidence beyond final outcome

pooled_controller.read: pre-registered public history shared across arms, never private scorer state
pooled_controller.purpose: wide-history diagnostic upper bound, not primary fair comparison

RARE.read: typed public observation plus attributable evidence and delayed selected-only credit

Meta-Team-L2-public.read: only public delivery-to-recipient evidence permitted by this card
Meta-Team-L2-public.purpose: closest published semantic adapter; NO-GO unless independently executable

closest_published.name: Meta-Team-L2-public
closest_published.reason: profile parser, public information cut, assignment consumer, cost contract and independent history are not yet executable; omission requires an explicit NO-GO row, never silent deletion

shared_execution_contract.candidate_registry: one immutable id@version/source/model/config digest for every arm
shared_execution_contract.candidate_menu: identical ordered menu and candidate versions in matched cells
shared_execution_contract.task_material: one sealed material/task/sandbox/scorer digest per root; no hidden gold in actor payload
shared_execution_contract.public_prefix: identical event-time read cut; future outcome and other policy state forbidden
shared_execution_contract.rng: pre-registered offer/selection schedule; preview->assignment->commit with no re-sampling
shared_execution_contract.ownership: producer defect, recipient-only, sink-only, mixed and UNKNOWN are distinct
shared_execution_contract.unknown: resource, binding, scorer, visibility or attribution uncertainty is UNKNOWN/no-update and remains in denominator
shared_execution_contract.cost: measured producer, recipient, judge, communication, retry, repair, scorer and replay cost; zero needs a receipt
shared_execution_contract.namespace: separate policy state, ledger, output and history namespace for each arm
shared_execution_contract.replay: every API event, state digest and selection receipt replayable from raw JSONL

split_and_statistics.unit: independent live stream, not episode row
split_and_statistics.development: PIPE3 seed 0 only for preflight after authority is granted
split_and_statistics.confirmation: a second structural root selected before seeing development results
split_and_statistics.generalization: leave_one_structural_root_out plus temporal split; no random row split
split_and_statistics.few_shot: 0-shot/1-shot/K-shot support from earlier sealed read cuts only
split_and_statistics.interval: stream-clustered 95% interval with UNKNOWN retained in denominator
split_and_statistics.minimum: at least two structural roots unless a written precision analysis pre-registers a different design

activation_blockers: seven executable arm adapters plus explicit Meta-Team NO-GO row
measured full-cost ledger and UNKNOWN denominator
provider/model/timezone/API configuration and new budget sealed
real API smoke success followed by bounded activation review

goal_comparison.ER-G1: design specifies delivery→judgment→attribution→future assignment→later quality/cost, but no live evidence yet
goal_comparison.ER-G2: RARE update boundary is specified; realtime/adaptation/stability remain unmeasured
goal_comparison.ER-G3: candidate matrix and two-root requirement are explicit; benchmark and baselines remain unfrozen
goal_comparison.ER-G4: API logging and failure accounting are specified; no new API/GPU run authorized
